description: Verkeer- Benzinepompen langs provinciale wegen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Dit bestand bevat de motorbrandstofverkooppunten (benzinepompen) gelegen langs de provinciale wegen. Tevens wordt de naam van de oliemaatschappij aangegeven. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are benzinestations, energiebedrijven, invk-mbvp-prov-wegen, provinciale-wegen, wegen. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2025-04-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
